layout.lede: Most small businesses can’t afford to hire for IT and marketing. We do both for you.

doors.title: Keep your tech working for you
doors.body: We help you choose the right software and manage it with cost savings in mind, so your business runs smoothly as it grows.

doors.title: Get found by more customers
doors.body: We manage your website, Google listing, ads and social media to bring in more leads.

layout.heading: You didn’t start a business to manage software or post on Instagram.
layout.sub: But someone has to do it. Most owners end up with one of these options.

cards.title: Hire someone
cards.body: A full-time IT or marketing person is expensive. A small team often doesn’t have enough work to keep them busy.

cards.title: Do it yourself
cards.body: Every hour you spend on admin is an hour you’re not spending on customers.

cards.title: Put it off
cards.body: Security gaps grow, you pay for software you don’t use, and competitors show up ahead of you in search.

stats.label: Owners spend about 11 hours a week on admin. That’s almost twice the time they spend on sales and growth.

body.heading: Software that works for your team, *not against it.*
body.body: We help you choose the right software, set it up, and manage it with cost savings in mind. Your team works more efficiently, and your systems keep up as you grow.

layout.heading: Software gets chosen once and never looked at again.
layout.sub: Each tool made sense when you bought it. But nobody’s job is to look at all of them together, and the costs add up slowly.

cards.title: Nobody keeps track
cards.body: You’re still paying for people who left and apps nobody remembers buying. The bill gets paid, so no one checks.

cards.title: Your tools don’t talk to each other
cards.body: Someone copies information from one system into another by hand, every week.

cards.title: Staff changes are messy
cards.body: New hires wait days for their logins. People who leave can still get in months later.

cards.title: You’re stuck figuring out who to call
cards.body: When something breaks, you’re the one working out which company should fix it.

stats.text: of software licences companies pay for are used regularly. The rest are empty seats.
of software buyers regretted a purchase they made in the last 18 months.

layout.heading: Four steps, in the right order.
layout.sub: Connecting tools you don’t need, or adding AI to messy data, just creates more work later. So we go one step at a time.

steps.title: Choose the right software
steps.text: We look at how your team works first. Often the best answer is to keep what you have and use more of it. If something needs replacing, we explain what it will cost to switch. We also pick software that will still fit when your team is twice the size.

steps.title: Set it up and connect it
steps.text: We move your data, set everything up and connect your tools, so nobody has to type the same information twice.

steps.title: Add AI where it helps
steps.text: We use AI for repeated tasks where it saves real time. We set the right permissions first, so it can’t show files to the wrong people. If AI won’t help, we’ll tell you.

steps.title: Run it day to day
steps.text: As you hire, accounts and licences are set up the same way every time, so growth doesn’t create a mess. We also keep licences in check and help your team when something goes wrong.

layout.heading: Seven services. One team.
layout.sub: Each service has its own page with more detail.

cards.title: Software selection and setup
cards.body: We help you choose the right tools, move your data and set everything up, with your next stage of growth in mind.

cards.title: Connected software
cards.body: Your tools share information automatically, so nobody types the same thing twice.

cards.title: Joining and leaving
cards.body: New staff get the right access on day one. People who leave lose it the same day.

cards.title: Licences and cost control
cards.body: We track who uses what and cut licences you don’t need, so you only pay for what you use.

cards.title: Backup and security
cards.body: 2-step login on every account, plus backup you control for your email and files.

cards.title: Support and vendor management
cards.body: One number to call. We fix most problems ourselves and deal with your vendors for the rest.

cards.title: AI where it helps
cards.body: We add AI to repeated tasks where it saves real time, with the right permissions set up first.

layout.sub: If what you use today works well, we keep it. We only suggest a change when it saves you time or money.

cards.title: Productivity
cards.body: Email, files and documents. Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Zoho Workplace.

cards.title: Communication
cards.body: Chat and video meetings. Teams, Slack, Zoho Cliq.

cards.title: CRM
cards.body: Your customers and sales. Zoho Bigin, HubSpot, Jobber.

cards.title: HR systems
cards.body: Your staff records, which control every other account. Rippling, Collage, Rise.

cards.title: Quotes, invoicing and payments
cards.body: From quote to paid, on time. Ignition, QuickBooks, Jobber.

cards.title: Bookkeeping and payroll
cards.body: The systems your accountant works from. QuickBooks, Zoho Books, Payworks, ADP.

cards.title: Job and project tracking
cards.body: What’s promised and what’s done. Jobber, Zoho FSM, Zoho Projects.

cards.title: Using something else?
cards.body: We work with what you already have when it’s a good fit.

layout.heading: Enter it once. It shows up everywhere.
layout.sub: We connect your software so information moves between your tools on its own. Nobody has to copy it from one system to another.

cards.title: When you hire someone
cards.body: You add them to your HR system once, with their start date and role. Then, automatically: email account created, added to team chat, set up in payroll.

cards.title: When a customer books a job
cards.body: The job is booked in Jobber or your booking tool. Then, automatically: added to the schedule, invoice created, customer saved in your CRM.

children.text: No retyping, fewer mistakes, and your team gets that time back.

layout.heading: One number for every vendor.
layout.sub: You don’t call Microsoft, QuickBooks or your HR system. You call us. We fix most problems ourselves. If a vendor needs to step in, we contact them, explain the problem and follow up until it’s fixed.

children.text: One number to call, or email us or open a ticket in your client portal. We reply by the next business day, or within one business hour with Faster response. Your team doesn’t lose an afternoon figuring out whose problem it is.

layout.heading: Your setup keeps up as your team grows.
layout.sub: What works for 5 people starts to break at 15. We plan for your next stage from the start, so you don’t have to switch providers or redo everything later.

cards.title: 5 people: set up properly
cards.body: Logins set up when someone joins, and removed the day they leave. Shared email and files. A secure login for everyone.

cards.title: 15 people: getting organized
cards.body: The same steps every time someone joins, changes roles or leaves. An HR system for staff records. Your main tools connected.

cards.title: 40 people: ready for more
cards.body: Joining, role changes and leaving handled automatically from your HR record. Permissions set by role and team. Software and licences reviewed regularly.

children.text: Your price scales per user, so your cost grows only as your team does.

body.heading: Help more customers find you *and choose you.*
body.body: We manage your website, search, ads, Google listing and social media. One team keeps it all working together, so more of the people who find you get in touch.

cards.title: Your website is slow
cards.body: Most local searches happen on a phone. If your site takes too long to load, people leave, and you still pay for the click.

cards.title: Leads go nowhere
cards.body: Your contact form sends leads to an inbox nobody checks. By the time someone replies, the customer has called someone else.

cards.title: Your listings don’t match
cards.body: Different hours on Google and Apple Maps, or an old phone number, make customers unsure about you.

cards.title: Nobody is watching the ads
cards.body: Ads get set up and left alone. Months later, your budget is going to searches that no longer bring in work.

cards.body: Fast, modern websites that work well on phones and make it easy to contact you. We host it, update it and keep it secure.

cards.title: Social media

cards.title: Reviews and email campaigns
cards.body: A regular newsletter keeps past customers in the loop, and a sign-up form on your website grows your list. A review request also goes out after every payment.

items.summary: Do I have to sign a long contract?
items.body: No. All services are month to month with 30 days’ notice. Websites have a one-time setup cost.

items.summary: Can you work with my current website?
items.body: Usually, yes. If fixing it would cost more than building a new one, we’ll tell you.

items.summary: Do I need a new website to run ads?
items.body: No. If your site is in good shape, we’ll say so and put your budget into ads instead.

items.summary: What is AI search, and does it matter?
items.body: More people now ask tools like ChatGPT or Google’s AI who to call. We set up your site so these tools can find and recommend you. It’s included with SEO.

items.summary: How are you different from a marketing agency?
items.body: Most agencies report on clicks. Because we can also manage the tools your team uses, we can follow a lead all the way to a booked job and show you which marketing brings in money.

items.summary: Will you manage my Google listing?
items.body: Yes, along with Bing and Apple. For many local businesses, it’s the thing that makes the biggest difference in the first month.

layout.heading: Common questions

items.summary: Do I have to sign a contract?
items.body: No. Everything is month to month with 30 days’ notice. A yearly commitment is optional and waives the Managed IT setup fee.

items.summary: Is the software included in the price?
items.body: No. You buy your software licences from the vendor at their price. Our fee is for the work. If we can get you a better price through our partners, we pass it on.

items.summary: Who counts as a user?
items.body: Anyone with a paid software licence, including staff and contractors. People who don’t use any software aren’t counted.

items.summary: Is 2-step login extra?
items.body: No. It’s part of every Managed IT plan, on every account.

items.summary: Are there any hidden fees?
items.body: No. Ad spend and one-time projects are always listed separately, so you know exactly what you’re paying for.

body.body: “Microsoft Support” writes from support@micros0ft-billing.co: “Your password expires today. Sign in now to keep your account active.” The sender’s address is misspelled, it rushes you with a deadline, and the button leads to a fake sign-in page.

layout.heading: Common questions

items.summary: Doesn’t Microsoft already back up my data?
items.body: Microsoft keeps its service running, but deleted email can only be recovered for 14 days by default, up to 30. After that, it’s gone. A separate backup covers you for longer.

items.summary: How fast can you restore files?
items.body: It depends on how much needs restoring. A single file or email is usually quick, and a whole mailbox takes longer. We start as soon as you tell us during business hours.

items.summary: Do you manage our laptops and phones?
items.body: No. We don’t manage laptops or phones. We protect the accounts on them. If you need device protection, we’ll point you to someone who does it properly.

items.summary: Will this make us hack-proof?
items.body: No one can promise that. The basics we set up stop the most common attacks, and backups mean you can recover if something gets through.

items.summary: Can you help with our cyber insurance form?
items.body: Yes, for the account and backup questions, like 2-step login and backups. Insurers also ask about device protection, which we don’t provide, so we’ll point you to someone who does.

items.summary: What do we do if we’re hacked?
items.body: Call us. We follow your incident plan: lock affected accounts, restore from backup and record what happened.

items.summary: Do we have to report a breach?
items.body: Under PIPEDA, breaches with a real risk of significant harm must be reported, and every breach must be recorded for 24 months. We’re not lawyers, and this isn’t legal advice.

layout.heading: What usually stops people.

cards.title: DMAP and RMPG don’t mix
cards.body: You can apply to one or the other, not both. For most retailers with bigger changes ahead, the larger DMAP grant is the better choice.

cards.title: LIFT is a loan
cards.body: It’s often listed next to grants, but it’s financing you pay back. Useful for the right project, but not free money.

cards.title: Funds can run out
cards.body: Ontario’s programs are first come, first served. An intake can close without much notice, so it’s worth asking early.

cards.title: The program decides, not us
cards.body: Approval and amounts are decided by the Ontario Centre of Innovation or BDC. Anyone who promises approval is selling something.

children.text: Most agencies run SEO through endless email threads, shared spreadsheets and trackers. Drafts get lost, feedback gets missed, and it’s hard to tell what’s been done.

layout.heading: Everything happens in your client portal.

steps.title: Choose your topics
steps.text: We suggest page topics based on what your customers search for, like a page for each service and each area you serve. You pick the ones you want.

steps.title: We create the page
steps.text: We write and design the page, then post a proof in your portal.

steps.title: Review and comment
steps.text: Leave feedback right on the proof, or ask for changes.

steps.title: Approve and go live
steps.text: Once you approve it, the page goes live on your website.

cards.title: Email when it’s your turn
cards.body: You get a notification when a page is ready for review, so nothing waits on you by accident.

cards.title: No more lost drafts
cards.body: Every proof, comment and approval is in one place, not spread across emails.

cards.title: A full history
cards.body: Every page we’ve created is saved in your archive, so you can always look back.

layout.lead: Pick topics, review pages and approve them in one place. You get an email when something needs you, and every page is saved for later.

$600 a month. A new page or blog post every month, search and AI-ready setup, and monthly reporting. Month to month, no long contract. See it in your Business Health Dashboard, included when your monthly plan totals over $400.

body.heading: See how you show up today.
body.body: We’ll check how your business appears on Google and in AI answers, and suggest the first pages we’d create. You keep the review, whether you work with us or not.

layout.heading: Common questions

items.summary: What is AI search?
items.body: More people now ask tools like ChatGPT or Google’s AI who to call. These tools rely most on your own website, then on reviews and mentions elsewhere, like directories and local “best of” lists. We set up your site so they can understand your business and recommend it.

items.summary: How long does SEO take?
items.body: Search results build over time. Most businesses start seeing progress within a few months, and it keeps growing as we add pages.

items.summary: Do I have to write anything?
items.body: No. We write and design every page. You just pick topics and approve the pages in your portal.

items.summary: How do I give feedback on a page?
items.body: Right in your client portal. Leave a comment on the proof, ask for changes, or approve it to go live.

items.summary: Can you guarantee first place on Google?
items.body: No one can honestly promise that. We focus on the steady work that helps you show up more often, and we show you the results every month.

items.summary: Do you work with my current website?
items.body: Yes. SEO and AI search works with any website, whether we built it or not. We just need access to add pages and make changes.
